summary: @servicetitan/thoughtspot-theme preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: This package is published as a ThoughtSpot CSS theme but declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads a Bun binary from oven-sh/bun releases for the host platform/arch, extracts it, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled obfuscated sibling script `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line blob using string-array rotation (`WV8StW`) and a custom-alphabet decoder (`hc1jfK9`), and `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscator.io-style (identifier renaming, string-map indirection). The preinstall path therefore causes an obfuscated payload to execute under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime on every `npm install`, bypassing scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. A CSS theme package has no legitimate need for a Bun runtime or for executing an opaque bundled binary at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
